summary.headline: Albertus Magnus on Astrological Books
summary.text: Editorial introduction to excerpts from Albertus Magnus’s Speculum astronomicum on licit and prohibited books, the Christian suppression of astrology, and the medieval transmission of Greek astrology through Arabic and Jewish authors. It identifies the Ghent codex 416, collated against the error-filled 1891 Paris edition, and quotes its title describing Albert’s classification of astronomical books as faithful or contrary to faith.
